A '''scabbard''' was a sheath for holding a [[Sword/Legends|sword]] or [[Dagger/Legends|dagger]].

During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], [[King/Legends|King]] [[Katuunko/Legends|Katuunko]] of [[Toydaria/Legends|Toydaria]] wore the [[Ceremonial sword/Legends|Toydarian ceremonial sword]] in a scabbard on his [[Belt/Legends|belt]]. [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Lonay]], one of [[Dark Prince|Prince]] [[Xizor/Legends|Xizor's]] [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] [[Vigo/Legends|Vigos]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], wore a jeweled dagger in a scabbard, which served as a symbol of his power over the life and [[Death/Legends|death]] of his subordinates.
